description: EasyParcel helps you compare courier options and track shipments in Malaysia and Singapore. Sign in with your EasyParcel account to get live shipping quotes, view your shipment records and details, track AWB status, request insurance quotes, and discover available couriers and drop-off points. This public version is read-only and does not create, cancel, or pay for shipments.

defaultPrompt: Compare courier rates for a 1 kg parcel from postcode 11950 in Penang to postcode 55100 in Kuala Lumpur.
